milestones.description: Uses count_in_box_at_least(kind=block, object=potted_poppy) because when a player right-clicks a flower_pot while holding a poppy, the block transforms from minecraft:flower_pot to minecraft:potted_poppy. This block state change is the definitive, deterministic completion signal. The box is centered on the flower pot at spawn-relative (2, 1, 2) with ±1 tolerance on X and Z. At scene initialization the block is minecraft:flower_pot (empty), so this rule is NOT pre-satisfied.
